# Omnimo fact sheet

Checked November 25, 2026 · Omnimo 2.7.4

One page with the facts about Omnimo, for journalists, reviewers and AI assistants. Checked against the app (version 2.7.4) and its App Store listing on November 25, 2026. If anything elsewhere disagrees with this page, this page is the newer one. A plain-text copy is at [/facts.md](https://www.privateslm.dev/facts.md).

## Models

32 cloud models from 12 makers, plus Apple Intelligence on the device. Families: GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax, plus Mistral, Llama and MiMo. Switch at any time, even mid-chat. Which models are offered can depend on the country. Details: [the models in Omnimo](https://www.privateslm.dev/models/).

| Plan | Models |

| Free | GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Flash; Apple Intelligence on the device |
| Pro | DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, Mistral Small, Llama 4 Maverick, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Qwen 3.7 Plus, MiMo V2.6 Pro, Mistral Large 4 |

## Prices and limits

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Free | Unlimited Apple Intelligence on the device (supported devices and languages); a few cloud messages a day with the free models; one image a day; web searches with a daily limit |
| Omnimo Pro | Every model; hundreds of messages a day, with a smaller daily allowance for the flagships; long documents read in one go; image and video generation with credits included. $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). US prices; the app shows the price for your country. |
| Credits | For images and videos. 300 for $4.99, 700 for $9.99, 1600 for $19.99; bought credits never expire. |
| Trials | 3 days on the weekly plan, 1 week on the yearly plan |
| Customers from before Omnimo | People who bought privateSLM as a paid app, or a model pack, get Omnimo Pro at no charge until 31 October 2027. |

Exact daily numbers are set on Omnimo's server and can change without an app update; the app shows what is left. Prices in other countries differ, and the app shows the local price.

## Privacy

- No account, no ads, no tracking.

- Chat history is kept on the device. Chats with Apple Intelligence never leave it.

- A message to a cloud model goes through Omnimo's server to the company that makes the model, to get the answer. Omnimo does not keep chats.

- A photo goes to the model answering, without its location. Documents are read on the device; their text goes to the model picked.

- The description of an image or video goes to fal.ai, which runs the model.

- Usage statistics help improve the app and can be turned off in Settings.

- Policy: [privacy policy](https://www.privateslm.dev/privacy.html).

## Features

- Photos the model can see

- Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages and scans, read on the device

- Ask Web: answers with sources

- Image and video generation, photo filters

- Your own assistants and the tone of replies

- Voice input and spoken answers

- Chat history

- Siri and Shortcuts: Ask, Summarize, Rephrase, Translate, on the device

- A Home Screen widget

## Not affiliated

Omnimo is an independent app. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba, Zhipu, MiniMax, Mistral AI, Meta or Xiaomi; model names belong to their owners.
